search_scope.source_policy: Primary sources preferred: ACL Anthology, arXiv, OpenReview, and project repositories when available.

entries.title: DRAG: Distilling RAG for SLMs from LLMs to Transfer Knowledge and Mitigate Hallucination via Evidence and Graph-based Distillation
entries.implication: Generic RAG-to-small-model distillation is not novel. The grounded-QA project must claim update-aware, citation-grounded, abstention-calibrated data construction rather than generic RAG distillation.

entries.title: Generate-then-Ground in Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-hop Question Answering
entries.implication: Multi-step generate/ground behavior and smaller-model grounding distillation already exist. The project needs a stronger distinction around evolving private KB snapshots, inline citation contracts, and amortized post-training examples.

entries.title: Bridging Relevance and Reasoning: Rationale Distillation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
entries.implication: Evidence/rationale selection alone is crowded. The project should keep selector baselines as controls, not the main contribution.

entries.title: LongCite: Enabling LLMs to Generate Fine-grained Citations in Long-Context QA
entries.implication: Citation-supervised SFT data is not novel. The project must evaluate citation-grounded correctness under compact evidence packs, abstention, and evolving-KB update amortization.

entries.title: DynaQuest: A Dynamic Question Answering Dataset Reflecting Real-World Knowledge Updates
entries.implication: Dynamic QA datasets already cover real-world knowledge updates. The grounded-QA project should not claim dynamic QA itself; it should claim amortized grounded-research training/evaluation over evolving private/domain KBs.

entries.title: DRAGOn: Designing RAG On Periodically Updated Corpus
entries.implication: Updated-corpus RAG benchmarking and automatic fresh-question generation are close to the evolving-KB evaluation story. The project must emphasize amortized post-training/scaffold behavior and citation-grounded answer support, not just dynamic benchmark construction.

entries.title: DRAGON: Domain-specific Robust Automatic Data Generation for RAG
entries.implication: Domain-specific RAG data generation is not enough for novelty. The project should frame its generated examples as post-training supervision for answer synthesis, inline citations, abstention, and update transfer rather than generic RAG dataset synthesis.

entries.title: GRACE: Reinforcement Learning for Grounded Response and Abstention under Contextual Evidence
entries.implication: Joint answer/abstain training under contextual evidence is now a direct neighbor. The project should position joint-action SFT/DPO as a data-construction and amortization study, not as the first joint grounding-abstention objective.

entries.title: Search-P1: Path-Centric Reward Shaping for Stable and Efficient Agentic RAG Training
entries.implication: Training agentic RAG trajectories is an active neighboring path. The grounded-QA project should avoid claiming agentic-search training as new and instead test whether expensive grounded research traces can be amortized into cheaper citation-faithful answer/scaffold behavior over update-heldout KB states.

entries.title: Can Compact Language Models Search Like Agents? Distillation-Guided Policy Optimization for Preserving Agentic RAG Capabilities
entries.implication: Compact-model RAG-agent distillation is now a direct neighbor. The grounded-QA project should not claim compact agentic-RAG capability preservation; its sharper claim must be citation-grounded answer/abstention correctness over evolving KB snapshots and lower-cost deployed answer/scaffold behavior.

entries.title: Open Data Synthesis for Deep Research
entries.implication: Large-scale synthetic data for agentic deep research already exists. The paper should frame its data as compact evidence-pack supervision for citation-grounded QA and abstention under KB updates, not as the first deep-research data synthesis framework.

entries.title: DeepSieve: Information Sieving via LLM-as-a-Knowledge-Router
entries.implication: Agentic decomposition and routing over heterogeneous sources is crowded. The grounded-QA paper should treat online source-routing agents as related but separate from amortizing the final grounded answer policy into cheaper inference.

entries.title: Training the Knowledge Base through Evidence Distillation and Write-Back Enrichment
entries.implication: Offline evidence distillation into the corpus is a close amortization alternative. The project should compare model/scaffold distillation against KB write-back or explicitly scope it as a different amortization target.

entries.title: KohakuRAG: A simple RAG framework with hierarchical document indexing
entries.implication: Citation-ready document RAG with hierarchy and abstention-aware voting is a close system-level baseline. The project should avoid claiming citation-grounded RAG itself and instead emphasize amortized post-training data and update-heldout grounded correctness.

entries.title: GROUNDEDKG-RAG: Grounded Knowledge Graph Index for Long-document Question Answering
entries.implication: Grounded indexes can reduce context cost without training a student. The paper should treat grounded retrieval/index construction as a competing amortization path or make clear that the target here is model/scaffold behavior distilled from expensive agents.

entries.title: OCC-RAG: Optimal Cognitive Core for Faithful Question Answering
entries.implication: Compact models specialized for faithful context QA with citations and abstention are now a very close model-family baseline. The project needs its evolving-KB/update-heldout protocol, teacher/scaffold amortization accounting, and private/domain KB framing to remain distinct.

entries.title: AgenticRAG: Agentic Retrieval for Enterprise Knowledge Bases
entries.implication: Enterprise-KB agentic RAG is an explicit neighboring deployment story. The grounded-QA paper should avoid claiming enterprise RAG system integration and focus on amortizing expensive grounded behavior into cheaper post-trained/scaffolded inference under update snapshots.

entries.title: Knowledge Distillation Must Account for What It Loses
entries.implication: The paper should include a distillation-loss accounting frame: answer support, citation support, abstention boundaries, update robustness, and coverage are preservation targets, not incidental metrics.

entries.title: LIT-RAGBench: Benchmarking Generator Capabilities of Large Language Models in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
entries.implication: Generator benchmarking for RAG includes abstention and evidence integration. The project needs a stronger evaluation claim around update robustness, cost per grounded answer, and citation-support correctness.

synthesis.current_novelty_hypothesis: The defensible contribution is not generic RAG distillation, citation SFT, dynamic QA, or abstention training. It is a measured data-construction and evaluation recipe for amortizing expensive grounded research behavior over evolving private/domain KBs, preserving inline citation support and abstention calibration under update splits.
claim_to_avoid: First updated-corpus RAG benchmark or automatic RAG data-generation framework.
First joint grounded-answer and abstention objective.
First agentic RAG training or trajectory-distillation method.
First compact model specialized for faithful context QA with citations and abstention.
First evidence-distillation amortization method for RAG.
required_before_paper_claim: Run the bounded Qwen 3B joint-action smoke and evaluate grounded correctness on the held-out future window.
Show that the contribution is not explainable as updated-corpus benchmark construction or domain RAG data generation alone.
Compare against a generic DRAG-like RAG distillation baseline or clearly justify why the available implementation is not comparable.
Compare against a LongCite-style citation SFT framing by reporting citation support, not just citation syntax.
Compare or position against compact faithful-context-QA models such as OCC-RAG and explain why evolving-KB update-heldout evaluation is the relevant distinction.
Position agentic-RAG trajectory training as a neighbor and report why the cheaper deployed artifact is a model/scaffold for grounded citation QA rather than an online search agent.
Add a distillation-loss statement covering preserved and lost teacher capabilities: answer support, citation support, abstention boundaries, update robustness, coverage, and cost.
Add a KB-update baseline inspired by WriteBack-RAG or state why model-side amortization is the target.
Use a trusted dated/private KB snapshot rather than only arXiv-id-inferred temporal splits.

llm_budget.note: Novelty watchlist construction used web/literature inspection only; no OpenAI API calls and no GPU jobs.
